finding.headline: "The Wearable Pump That Didn't Fit"
finding.problem: "I bought the pump everyone raved about. It hurt, it didn't work, and my baby refused bottles. I wasted money I needed for nappies."
finding.person: Mum who pre-bought a £65 wearable pump; wrong flange size, low output, baby won't take bottle anyway (The Sun £90.91 regret).
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.
